'''Jorm Alvic''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a long-time friend of [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Perre Needmo]]. He was middle-aged following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], and by [[44 ABY]] he had become the director of Needmo's show, ''[[The Perre Needmo Newshour]]''.
